text: {"lessons":["Selling C, D, and E at gains felt rewarding, but those realized profits did not protect my account from later losses; I should judge trades by my overall plan, not the pleasure of locking in a gain.","I held through several monthly declines without trading, then made sizable purchases and later shifted positions. I should set clear position-size and rebalancing rules in advance rather than react to how gains or losses feel.","Past price changes do not predict future changes, so I should not treat recent performance as a signal. I will base each buy, sell, or hold decision on diversification, risk, and my long-term goals."]}
